content.label:
I really enjoy this app. The dictation works extremely well; I'm actively writing with it right now.

However, the main issue is the fact that the app constantly has to be on. I don't enjoy my microphone always being active, but if I turn it off, I have to open the Typeless app every time I want to use it. 

There has to be a workaround or a better solution to make this more seamless.
